item.title: [+1] Rupee slips below to 95.18 against dollar on elevated oil prices
item.description:
Signal: a weaker rupee. 22 reports from The New Indian Express, TradingView, Deccan Chronicle and 17 more. Related: “Rupee falls as importer demand and high crude prices weigh”. Turn: earlier readings (23 Oct) pointed the other way.

Pharma & healthcare: mild tailwind (+1) — Pharma exporters gain

Why it matters: A weaker rupee raises the cost of oil and other imports and imported inflation, but lifts IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee −3, Inflation outlook −1, Foreign investor flows −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
